facts.statement: The game is titled 1-2 Punch.
facts.sourceSentence: "1-2 PUNCH"

facts.statement: The game has a recommended minimum age of 14.
The game is played by exactly two players.
facts.sourceSentence: "2 PLAYERS"

facts.statement: The stated playing time is 30 minutes.
facts.sourceSentence: "30 MINUTES"

facts.statement: The game was designed by Chris Williams.
facts.sourceSentence: "GAME DESIGN Chris Williams"

facts.statement: Character art is credited to Maristella Nicoletto.
facts.sourceSentence: "CHARACTER ART Maristella Nicoletto"

facts.statement: Game art is credited to Kalli Williams.
facts.sourceSentence: "GAME ART Kalli Williams"

facts.statement: The game's theme is a boxing match between two titans in a ring.
facts.sourceSentence: "Ladies and gentlemen, boxing fans from around the world gather tonight to witness two titans clash in the ring!"

facts.statement: One boxer is Cadman Morris, associated with the blue corner and described as the challenger from Newport, Wales.
facts.sourceSentence: "In the blue corner is our challenger hailing from Newport, Wales, weighing 153lbs, 5ft 9in tall, the one and only, the notorious, the warrior: Cadman Morris!"

facts.statement: Cadman Morris is described as weighing 153 lbs.
facts.sourceSentence: "In the blue corner is our challenger hailing from Newport, Wales, weighing 153lbs, 5ft 9in tall, the one and only, the notorious, the warrior: Cadman Morris!"

facts.statement: The other boxer is Darius Akachi, described as wearing red and white trunks, an Olympic gold medal winner and the current heavyweight titleholder.
facts.sourceSentence: "Wearing red and white trunks, weighing in at 216lbs and standing at an intimidating 6ft 3in, an Olympic gold medal winner and our current heavyweight titleholder, perhaps the greatest of all time: Darius Akachi!"

facts.statement: Darius Akachi is described as weighing 216 lbs.
facts.sourceSentence: "Wearing red and white trunks, weighing in at 216lbs and standing at an intimidating 6ft 3in, an Olympic gold medal winner and our current heavyweight titleholder, perhaps the greatest of all time: Darius Akachi!"

facts.statement: 1-2 Punch is a strategic boxing card game for two opposing players.
facts.sourceSentence: "1-2 Punch is an easy to learn strategic boxing card game that pits two players against one another in the ring."

facts.statement: The core skill of the game is predicting the opponent's moves in order to land punches.
facts.sourceSentence: "Predict your opponent's moves to land the perfect punch!"

facts.statement: The game contains 2 Boxer Cards.
facts.sourceSentence: "2 Boxer Cards, 16 Action Cards, 6 Guard Cards, 1 Rules Sheet"

facts.statement: The game contains 16 Action Cards.
facts.sourceSentence: "2 Boxer Cards, 16 Action Cards, 6 Guard Cards, 1 Rules Sheet"

facts.statement: The game contains 6 Guard Cards.
facts.sourceSentence: "2 Boxer Cards, 16 Action Cards, 6 Guard Cards, 1 Rules Sheet"

facts.statement: The game contains 1 Rules Sheet.
facts.sourceSentence: "2 Boxer Cards, 16 Action Cards, 6 Guard Cards, 1 Rules Sheet"

facts.statement: A player wins by knocking out the opponent, which is achieved by breaking all three of the opponent's Guards.
facts.sourceSentence: "Knock out your opponent by breaking all three of their Guards."

facts.statement: During setup, each player chooses a color — either red or blue — and takes all cards of that color.
facts.sourceSentence: "1. Each player must choose a color (red or blue) and take all cards of that color."

facts.statement: The ring is made up of three designated table areas.
facts.sourceSentence: "2. Designate three areas on the table to make up the ring."

facts.statement: The area directly in front of each player is that player's corner, and the area between the two players is the center ring.
facts.sourceSentence: "The area directly in front of each player is their respective corner and the area in-between them is the center ring."

facts.statement: At the start of the game, the blue player's boxer card begins in the blue player's corner.
facts.sourceSentence: "3. The blue player must start with their boxer card in their corner and the red player must start with their boxer card in the center ring."

facts.statement: At the start of the game, the red player's boxer card begins in the center ring.
facts.sourceSentence: "3. The blue player must start with their boxer card in their corner and the red player must start with their boxer card in the center ring."

facts.statement: Each player places their three Guard cards next to themselves with the ready sides face up.
facts.sourceSentence: "a. Place your three Guard cards next to you with the ready sides face up."

facts.statement: Each player creates their own discard pile by placing one of their Rest cards face up next to them.
facts.sourceSentence: "b. Place one of your Rest cards face up next to you to create your own discard pile."

facts.statement: Each player holds their remaining cards in hand, hidden from the opponent.
facts.sourceSentence: "c. Hold the remaining cards in your hand hidden from your opponent."

facts.statement: During setup, the blue player chooses one card from their hand and discards it.
facts.sourceSentence: "5. If you are the blue player, choose one card from your hand and discard it."

facts.statement: The blue player then names a card that the red player must discard.
facts.sourceSentence: "Next, you must name a card that the red player must discard."

facts.statement: The card blue discards and the card blue names for red need not be the same card.
facts.sourceSentence: "These do not have to be the same cards and are in addition to the Rest cards both players already discarded."

facts.statement: These two setup discards are additional to the Rest cards each player already discarded.
facts.sourceSentence: "These do not have to be the same cards and are in addition to the Rest cards both players already discarded."

facts.statement: Neither of the two additional setup discards may be a Rest card.
facts.sourceSentence: "Neither of these additional discards may be a Rest card."

facts.statement: An example of the setup discard step: Blue discards their Retreat card and directs Red to discard their Punch card.
facts.sourceSentence: "For example, Blue discards their Retreat and tells Red to discard their Punch."

facts.statement: Each round consists of three phases, in order: Plan, Fight, and Discard.
facts.sourceSentence: "Each round has three phases: Plan, Fight, and Discard."

facts.statement: Both players complete each phase simultaneously.
facts.sourceSentence: "Both you and your opponent must complete each phase at the same time."

facts.statement: In the Plan phase, a player chooses any two action cards from their hand and places them face-down in any order next to their boxer.
facts.sourceSentence: "Choose any two action cards from your hand and place them in any order face-down next to your boxer."

facts.statement: Of the two planned cards, the one closest to the boxer is the first action and the other is the second action.
facts.sourceSentence: "The card closest to your boxer is your first action and the other card is your second action."

facts.statement: Both players have the same set of cards.
facts.sourceSentence: "Both you and your opponent have the same set of cards and may look through each other's discard pile at any time."

facts.statement: Players may look through each other's discard pile at any time.
facts.sourceSentence: "Both you and your opponent have the same set of cards and may look through each other's discard pile at any time."

facts.statement: In the Fight phase, both players simultaneously flip their first action card face up and compare the cards' timings to determine resolution order.
facts.sourceSentence: "You and your opponent must flip your first action card face up at the same time and compare their timings to determine the order they are resolved."

facts.statement: The player whose card has the lower timing resolves their action first.
facts.sourceSentence: "The player with the lower timing on their card must resolve their action first."

facts.statement: If both cards have the same timing, the actions resolve simultaneously.
facts.sourceSentence: "If the timing is the same on both cards, they are resolved at the same time."

facts.statement: The Jab card has a timing of 1.
facts.sourceSentence: "For example, if Red played a Jab and Blue played a Retreat, Red would resolve their Jab first since it has a timing of 1 and Retreat has a timing of 2."

facts.statement: The Retreat card has a timing of 2.
facts.sourceSentence: "For example, if Red played a Jab and Blue played a Retreat, Red would resolve their Jab first since it has a timing of 1 and Retreat has a timing of 2."

facts.statement: In the worked example, Red's Jab resolves before Blue's Retreat because Jab's timing is lower.
facts.sourceSentence: "For example, if Red played a Jab and Blue played a Retreat, Red would resolve their Jab first since it has a timing of 1 and Retreat has a timing of 2."
